context: Interactive scatter plot of 5000 synthetic particles in 8 categories with quadtree-powered k-nearest-neighbor highlight on mouseover, Voronoi overlay toggle, and zoom/pan
first_impression: Structurally honest spatial demo — no baseline violations or misleading encodings, but data lives in raw pixel space with no scale infrastructure.
what_works: Color uses a qualitative ordinal scale (Tol palette) appropriate for categorical data; zoom transform is correctly inverted before quadtree queries, so nearest-neighbor detection remains accurate across zoom levels.
what_doesnt: Voronoi join uses no key function (.join('path') without d => d.id), risking element identity issues if data order ever changes; particle radii are randomized decoratively but are not tied to any data dimension, so the size channel carries no information and could mislead viewers into seeking meaning in dot size.
